name: CONCEALED_ENTRANCES_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/9/351B 'Concealed entrances sign W5-103' (sideways A4). 600 diamond (E & F 600) drawn as bounding square 848.53; Series C black letters on yellow reflectorised background, C = 80 letter height, D = 50 gap between the lines, A = 537 (CONCEALED), B = 531 (ENTRANCES); the two lines centred vertically (tops 319.3 / 449.3). Border drawn thick with a thin outer line but not dimensioned: yellow edge 10 / black border 20 / R40 as the AS 1743 600 diamonds (W6-10). AS 1744 C widths 506 / 494 (sheet about 6% wider). panel_px = the sheet's diamond extent widened by the tip rounding (R40: 16.6 each side) to the sharp bounding square.
